title: Diagnose before the next fix attempt for non-reproducible CI failures
context: Windows CI platform-matrix test repeatedly failed in overlayAttributeSourcesAreSafe/safeOverlayTree with identical generic messages. Two prior targeted fixes (handling ENOENT, then EPERM/EBUSY/EACCES) didn't resolve it. Cannot reproduce locally, and guessing the next fix without visibility is inefficient. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.).
decision: Add specific console.error at every early-return condition and exception catch in both functions, logging what actually caused the refusal. Purely diagnostic instrumentation — no behavior changes — to identify the specific failing check on the next CI run before attempting another blind fix.
consequences: Next Windows CI failure will emit specific diagnostic logs naming the exact check that refused
Fix attempt can target the actual root cause instead of hypothesis-driven guessing
CI artifact logs will contain granular diagnostic trail for this iteration and future debugging
Console.error output will be verbose during failure cases
alternatives_rejected: Continue iterating with hypothesis-driven fixes based on generic error messages
Set up Windows VM locally to attempt reproduction
Add only a single catch-all diagnostic log message instead of per-check instrumentation
Wait for additional CI failures to accumulate before investigating
